scoring_justification: Full recompute of dE_dP from raw Schrödinger solutions is computationally heavy and cannot run in verifier sandbox; result-level compare against paper's digitized model outputs is used, supplemented by structural trend checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for dE_dP and electric fields extracted from paper figures/text
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.3b (dE_dP for GaN/AlGaN QWs: 36,33,30,27,24 meV/GPa for 6,10,16,24,32 ML; text: field 0.66 MV/cm at 0 GPa, 0.87 MV/cm at 10 GPa for 8 nm well); Fig.2 (dE_dP for wurtzite InGaN/GaN: 20,10,0,-10,-20,-30 meV/GPa for 1,2,2.5,3.5,4,5 nm); Fig.5 (cubic InGaN/GaN constant ~28.5 meV/GPa).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Digitized from paper plots, rounded to nearest integer for dE_dP; field values directly transcribed.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values taken directly from the paper's reported model results; the reference solve.sh uses exactly these values.

outputs.description: Pressure coefficients dE_E/dP and built-in electric fields for GaN/Al0.17Ga0.83N quantum wells of thicknesses 6–32 monolayers; field values only required for the 8 nm well (others may be null).
Pressure coefficients dE_E/dP for wurtzite In0.2Ga0.8N/GaN quantum wells with well widths 1–5 nm.
Pressure coefficients dE_E/dP for cubic In0.1Ga0.9N/GaN quantum wells with well widths 0.6–5 nm.

output_contract.notes: Reproduces the computational model for strain-induced piezoelectric polarization and resulting pressure coefficients of optical transition energies in wurtzite InGaN/GaN, GaN/AlGaN, and cubic InGaN/GaN quantum wells.
